notes: Fixed shortcut icons showing as broken-image glyphs in the Shortcuts preview — the preview page's security policy didn't allow the icon format shortcuts actually use, blocking every real one.

Fixed all four Computer-tab previews (Volume/Brightness, Power Buttons, Bluetooth & Wi-Fi, Power Plan) showing at different widths — the real panel is a fixed width so every card on it is that same width; the previews now match.
Video now has a real, live preview — an actual loop of your chosen file, not just the Source/Fill dropdowns.
Weather now has a real, live preview too — today's actual conditions in your actual chosen icon style, not a placeholder.
Weather tab's Search and Use Mine buttons moved onto the Location row instead of sitting alone on their own row.
